title: CPF Module Schema: Azure Managed Disk module
description: JSON schema for CPF module 'cpf-azure-prdsvc-manageddisk'. Use this to generate Terraform code that calls the CPF module.

app_id.description: (Required) A descriptive name (abbreviation) for the workload (application) as it is registered in Leanix. The identifier format in Leanix is 'APP-12345', for the purpose of naming resources only 5 number will be used.

attach_disk_to_vm.description: (Required) Whether to attach the disk to a virtual machine. When false, creates a standalone disk for VMSS scenarios.

availability_zone.description: (Optional) The Availability Zone in which this Managed Disk should be located. Make sure the disk sku you want to use can be created in availability zone.

caching.description: (Optional) Specifies the caching requirements for this Data Disk.

context.description: (Optional) Application context information for the resource(s) (max 71 chars).

data_access_auth_mode.description: (Optional)Specifies the authentication mode for data access.

disk_encryption_set_id.description: (Required) The resource ID of a Disk Encryption Set which should be used to encrypt this Managed Disk.

disk_iops_read_only.description: (Optional) The number of IOPS allowed across all VMs mounting the shared disk as read-only; only settable for UltraSSD disks and PremiumV2 disks with shared disk enabled. One operation can transfer between 4k and 256k bytes.

disk_iops_read_write.description: (Optional) The number of IOPS allowed for this disk; only settable for UltraSSD disks and PremiumV2 disks. One operation can transfer between 4k and 256k bytes.

disk_mbps_read_only.description: (Optional) The bandwidth allowed across all VMs mounting the shared disk as read-only; only settable for UltraSSD disks and PremiumV2 disks with shared disk enabled. MBps means millions of bytes per second.

disk_mbps_read_write.description: (Optional) The bandwidth allowed for this disk; only settable for UltraSSD disks and PremiumV2 disks. MBps means millions of bytes per second.

disk_size_gb.description: (Optional) Specifies the size of the managed disk to create in gigabytes. If create_option is Copy or FromImage, then the value must be equal to or greater than the source's size. The size can only be increased. Defaults to `128`

environment.description: (Required) The environment where the resource is deployed. Given as abbreviation to leave more characters to the other naming components (max 3 chars).

gallery_image_reference_id.description: (Optional) ID of a Gallery Image Version to copy when create_option is FromImage. This field cannot be specified if image_reference_id is specified. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

hyper_v_generation.description: (Optional) The HyperV Generation of the Disk when the source of an Import or Copy operation targets a source that contains an operating system. Possible values are V1 and V2. For ImportSecure it must be set to V2. Changing this forces a new resource to be created. Defaults to `V2`

image_reference_id.description: (Optional) ID of an existing platform/marketplace disk image to copy from

instance.description: (Optional) Instance number, if context includes/requires multiple resources of the same type (max 3 int).

lun.description: (Optional) The Logical Unit Number of the Data Disk, which needs to be unique within the Virtual Machine. Required when virtual_machine_id is provided. Valid range is 0-63.

max_shares.description: (Optional) The maximum number of VMs that can attach to the disk at the same time. Value greater than one indicates a disk that can be mounted on multiple VMs at the same time.

os_type.description: (Optional) Specify a value when the source is an Import, Copy or Image.

performance_tier.description: (Optional) The disk performance tier to use. This feature is currently supported only for premium SSDs.

resource_group_name.description: (Required) Name of the Resource Group in which to create the managed disk.

source_resource_id.description: (Optional) The ID of an existing Managed Disk or Snapshot to copy from.

source_uri.description: (Optional) URI to a valid VHD file to be used for the disk creation.

storage_account_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the Storage Account where the source_uri is located. Required when create_option is set to `Import` or `ImportSecure`. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

storage_account_type.description: (Optional) The type of storage to use for the managed disk. Possible values are Standard_LRS, StandardSSD_ZRS, Premium_LRS, PremiumV2_LRS, Premium_ZRS, StandardSSD_LRS or UltraSSD_LRS.

tags.description: (Optional) Tags to be set on each resource.

trusted_launch_enabled.description: (Optional) Specifies if Trusted Launch is enabled for the Managed Disk. Changing this forces a new resource to be created.

virtual_machine_id.description: (Optional) The ID of the virtual machine to attach the disk to. If null, creates a standalone disk.

agent_instructions.summary: To provision 'Manageddisk' via Terraform, call this CPF module with the inputs defined below. Required inputs have no default and must be provided.
agent_instructions.module_type_notes: This is a single-service CPF module. It provisions one Azure resource type.
agent_instructions.naming_convention: Resource names are auto-generated by the module using app_id, environment, and region.
